name: web-personalpage
description: 静态个人主页，带 Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1 的内容后台

scripts.project:create: wrangler pages project create personal-page --production-branch main
scripts.secret:password: wrangler pages secret put ADMIN_PASSWORD --project-name personal-page
scripts.secret:session: wrangler pages secret put SESSION_SECRET --project-name personal-page
